subtitle: Quantifiers: much, many, some, a few, a lot of
instructions: Answer all questions. For questions 1 to 5, circle the correct word. For questions 6 to 10, circle the correct words. [10 marks]

items.text: There are ( many / much ) pupils in the hall: forty.
We have not got ( much / many ) flour for the cake.
How ( many / much ) bottles are on the shelf?
She does not spend ( much / many ) time on games.
There is too ( much / many ) smoke in the kitchen.

sections.heading: Section B — choose the correct words

items.text: She packed ( a few / much ) sandwiches: two for lunch.
They collected ( a lot of / a little ) plastic bottles: eighty for recycling.
There is ( some / many ) Milo in the mug.
We did not use ( much / many ) paint today.
He knows ( many / much ) stories about Melaka.
